variables.label: Aerosol optical depth 550 nm (dust/smoke haze)
variables.source: CERES SYN1deg via NASA POWER (parameter AOD_55)
variables.aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)
variables.notes: Column aerosol optical depth; high values in the dry season reflect Saharan dust and biomass burning.

variables.label: Aerosol optical depth 840 nm
variables.source: CERES SYN1deg via NASA POWER (parameter AOD_84)
variables.aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)
variables.notes: Longer-wavelength AOD; relatively more sensitive to coarse dust than to smoke.

variables.label: Downward shortwave radiation
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
variables.aggregation: area-weighted mean of 1/24° cells (cell coverage fraction x cos lat)

variables.label: Vapour pressure deficit
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
variables.aggregation: area-weighted mean of 1/24° cells (cell coverage fraction x cos lat)
variables.notes: Atmospheric dryness; high VPD stresses crops. Coverage 2018-01..2025-12.

variables.label: Palmer Drought Severity Index
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
variables.aggregation: area-weighted mean of 1/24° cells (cell coverage fraction x cos lat)
variables.notes: Negative = drought. Not ratio-indexable. TerraClimate PDSI is strongly negative across South Sudan in 2018-2025 (country mean ~ -6.6) because its ERA5-driven precipitation is well below its 1991-2020 climatology; treat as relative, and cross-check with IMERG-based spei3. Coverage 2018-01..2025-12.

variables.aggregation: county mean as computed in Drive pipeline (POWER grid cells averaged over county)
variables.label: SPEI-3 drought index
variables.source: Derived: IMERG precipitation minus Thornthwaite PET, 3-month SPEI vs county 2000-2026 history
variables.notes: Below -1 = dry, above +1 = wet. Not ratio-indexable (can be <= 0).

variables.label: Extreme dry month (flag)
variables.notes: Precipitation below the 10th percentile; never flagged in months whose 10th pct is 0 (normal dry season). County-mean value compared with the same county's 1991-2020 TerraClimate climatology for the same calendar month (empirical percentile over 30 years). 1 = extreme, 0 = not. 2018-2025 is drier and hotter than 1991-2020 in TerraClimate, so dry/heat flags fire ~30% of months and wet ~4%.
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS; percentiles computed by team
variables.aggregation: flag on county-mean series

variables.label: Extreme heat month (flag)
variables.notes: Mean daily max temperature above the 90th percentile. County-mean value compared with the same county's 1991-2020 TerraClimate climatology for the same calendar month (empirical percentile over 30 years). 1 = extreme, 0 = not. 2018-2025 is drier and hotter than 1991-2020 in TerraClimate, so dry/heat flags fire ~30% of months and wet ~4%.
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS; percentiles computed by team
variables.aggregation: flag on county-mean series

variables.label: Extreme wet month (flag)
variables.notes: Precipitation above the 90th percentile. County-mean value compared with the same county's 1991-2020 TerraClimate climatology for the same calendar month (empirical percentile over 30 years). 1 = extreme, 0 = not. 2018-2025 is drier and hotter than 1991-2020 in TerraClimate, so dry/heat flags fire ~30% of months and wet ~4%.
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS; percentiles computed by team
variables.aggregation: flag on county-mean series

variables.label: Extreme-weather flags (count)
variables.notes: Sum of tc_extreme_wet, tc_extreme_dry, tc_extreme_heat. County-mean value compared with the same county's 1991-2020 TerraClimate climatology for the same calendar month (empirical percentile over 30 years). 1 = extreme, 0 = not. 2018-2025 is drier and hotter than 1991-2020 in TerraClimate, so dry/heat flags fire ~30% of months and wet ~4%.
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS; percentiles computed by team
variables.aggregation: flag on county-mean series

variables.label: Active fire detections
variables.source: MODIS MOD14A1/MYD14A1 v061 (Terra+Aqua daily 1 km FireMask) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
variables.aggregation: count of daily 1 km fire pixels (FireMask 7-9, all confidence levels) inside county, summed over Terra and Aqua and all days of the month
variables.notes: Comparable to FIRMS MODIS counts (FIRMS API not reachable from build env). Strongly seasonal (dry season Nov-Mar). index_ok false because many county-months are 0.

variables.label: Burned area
variables.source: MODIS MCD64A1 v061 burned area via Microsoft Planetary Computer
variables.aggregation: sum of burned 500 m pixels (Burn_Date>0) x pixel area (sinusoidal equal-area, 0.2147 km2)
variables.notes: Monthly burned area; zero in most wet-season months.

variables.label: Burned area (% of county)
variables.source: MODIS MCD64A1 v061 burned area via Microsoft Planetary Computer
variables.aggregation: burned pixels / all pixels in county x 100
county mean as computed in Drive pipeline (POWER grid cells averaged over county)
variables.label: Precipitation (IMERG)
variables.source: GPM IMERG V07 Final via NASA POWER (IMERG_PRECTOT)
variables.notes: mm/day from POWER converted to mm/month.

variables.label: Precipitation (MERRA-2 bias-corrected)
variables.source: MERRA-2 via NASA POWER (parameter PRECTOTCORR)
variables.aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)
variables.notes: POWER gives mm/day; multiplied by days in month.

variables.label: Precipitation (TerraClimate)
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
variables.aggregation: area-weighted mean of 1/24° cells (cell coverage fraction x cos lat)
variables.notes: About 40% lower than IMERG (precip_mm) on average for 2018-2025; use for spatial detail, not absolute totals. Coverage 2018-01..2025-12.

variables.aggregation: county mean as computed in Drive pipeline (POWER grid cells averaged over county)
variables.label: Root-zone soil wetness (top 1 m)
variables.source: MERRA-2 reanalysis via NASA POWER (GWETROOT)

variables.label: Soil moisture (TerraClimate)
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
variables.aggregation: area-weighted mean of 1/24° cells (cell coverage fraction x cos lat)
variables.notes: Plant-extractable soil water at end of month. Coverage 2018-01..2025-12.

variables.aggregation: county mean as computed in Drive pipeline (POWER grid cells averaged over county)
variables.label: Average daily maximum temperature
variables.source: MERRA-2 reanalysis via NASA POWER (T2M_MAX_AVG)

variables.aggregation: county mean as computed in Drive pipeline (POWER grid cells averaged over county)
variables.label: Average daily minimum temperature
variables.source: MERRA-2 reanalysis via NASA POWER (T2M_MIN_AVG)

variables.label: Hottest hour of the month (2 m)
variables.source: MERRA-2 via NASA POWER (parameter T2M_MAX)
variables.aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)
variables.notes: Single highest hourly 2 m air temperature in the month.

variables.label: Max temperature (TerraClimate)
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
variables.aggregation: area-weighted mean of 1/24° cells (cell coverage fraction x cos lat)
variables.notes: Monthly mean of daily maximum temperature. Coverage 2018-01..2025-12.

variables.aggregation: county mean as computed in Drive pipeline (POWER grid cells averaged over county)
variables.label: Mean air temperature (2 m)
variables.source: MERRA-2 reanalysis via NASA POWER (T2M)

variables.label: Min temperature (TerraClimate)
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
variables.aggregation: area-weighted mean of 1/24° cells (cell coverage fraction x cos lat)
variables.notes: Monthly mean of daily minimum temperature. Coverage 2018-01..2025-12.

variables.label: Evapotranspiration, annual (MODIS)
variables.source: MODIS MOD16A3GF v061 (gap-filled annual) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
variables.aggregation: mean of valid cells in county
variables.notes: Planetary Computer only hosts the annual MOD16A3GF (no 8-day MOD16A2), so ET is annual (date = YYYY-07-01). Open water, urban and barren pixels are fill in MOD16 and excluded (e.g. permanent Sudd open water).

variables.label: Actual evapotranspiration
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
variables.aggregation: area-weighted mean of 1/24° cells (cell coverage fraction x cos lat)
variables.notes: Water actually evaporated/transpired; tracks vegetation water use. Coverage 2018-01..2025-12.

variables.label: Climatic water deficit
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
variables.aggregation: area-weighted mean of 1/24° cells (cell coverage fraction x cos lat)
variables.notes: PET minus AET; 0 when demand is fully met, so ratio to 2018 can be undefined. Coverage 2018-01..2025-12.

variables.aggregation: county mean as computed in Drive pipeline (POWER grid cells averaged over county)
variables.label: Potential evapotranspiration (Thornthwaite)
variables.source: Derived (Thornthwaite) from MERRA-2 T2M via NASA POWER
variables.notes: Computed by the team from monthly mean temperature.

variables.label: Reference evapotranspiration (Penman-Monteith)
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
variables.aggregation: area-weighted mean of 1/24° cells (cell coverage fraction x cos lat)

variables.label: Runoff
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
variables.aggregation: area-weighted mean of 1/24° cells (cell coverage fraction x cos lat)
variables.notes: Often 0 in the dry season, so ratio to 2018 can be undefined. Coverage 2018-01..2025-12.

variables.label: Strongest hourly wind at 10 m
variables.source: MERRA-2 via NASA POWER (parameter WS10M_MAX)
variables.aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)
variables.notes: Maximum hourly 10 m wind speed in the month (storm/dust-wind proxy).

variables.label: Wind speed (10 m)
variables.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
variables.aggregation: area-weighted mean of 1/24° cells (cell coverage fraction x cos lat)

variables.label: Wind speed at 10 m
variables.source: MERRA-2 via NASA POWER (parameter WS10M)
variables.aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)

variables.label: Wind speed at 2 m
variables.source: MERRA-2 via NASA POWER (parameter WS2M)
variables.aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)

variables.label: Civilian targeting events (ACLED)

variables.aggregation: sum of ACLED events/fatalities in county-month

variables.label: Displacement events tracked (DTM)
variables.source: IOM DTM South Sudan Event Tracking (2020-2025)
variables.aggregation: count of distinct Event Tracking records
variables.notes: Flash-displacement monitoring of sudden events; not exhaustive -- zeros (Jan 2020+) mean no event tracked. No 2018-2019 data published. 2024-25 includes arrivals fleeing Sudan war.

variables.label: IDPs present (DTM)
variables.aggregation: sum over baseline locations in county
variables.source: IOM DTM South Sudan Mobility Tracking - Baseline Assessment (rounds 2,4-16)
variables.notes: Stock at round reference month (2018-06, 2018-12, 2019-03, 2019-06, 2019-11, 2020-03, 2020-09, 2020-12, 2021-09, 2021-12, 2022-08, 2023-04, 2024-09, 2025-02); no values between rounds. Round 2 (Jun 2018) has partial coverage; rounds 1 and 3 not published at county level.

variables.label: New returnee arrivals (DTM event tracking)
variables.source: IOM DTM South Sudan Event Tracking (2020-2025)
variables.aggregation: sum of individuals over Event Tracking records, by month of event start
variables.notes: Flash-displacement monitoring of sudden events; not exhaustive -- zeros (Jan 2020+) mean no event tracked. No 2018-2019 data published. 2024-25 includes arrivals fleeing Sudan war.

variables.notes: Flash-displacement monitoring of sudden events; not exhaustive -- zeros (Jan 2020+) mean no event tracked. No 2018-2019 data published. 2024-25 includes arrivals fleeing Sudan war.

variables.source: WHO / MoH Master Facility List, April 2025 (HDX)
variables.aggregation: count of listed facilities by county code

variables.label: Health facilities per 100k people
variables.notes: Denominator WorldPop 2025 county population.

variables.source: WHO / MoH Master Facility List, April 2025 (HDX)

variables.label: Hospitals

variables.aggregation: count of listed facilities by county code
variables.label: Hospitals per 100k people
variables.notes: Denominator WorldPop 2025 county population.

variables.label: UNMISS deployment present
variables.aggregation: 1 if any UNMISS deployment location in county during year
variables.notes: Base/team-site level, not patrol coverage. 2025 from Jan 2025 deployment map.

variables.label: UNMISS troops deployed (est.)
variables.aggregation: sum of Geo-PKO troop estimates at county locations, mean over the year's map timepoints
variables.notes: Geo-PKO estimates troop numbers from unit sizes on UN maps (approximate). 2025 = Oct 2024 values for locations still shown on the Jan 2025 map. UNPOL/FPU police strength not fully included.

variables.label: Population (WorldPop)
variables.source: WorldPop Global2 R2025A constrained 1 km (UN-adjusted), 2015-2030 series
variables.aggregation: sum of pixels within county
variables.notes: Modelled estimates; 2018-2025 from the R2025A 2015-2030 projection product. Denominator for per-capita rates. Abyei summed from the Sudan (SDN) grid since the SSD grid excludes it. Does not capture conflict displacement dynamics well.
